name: robo-auction
description: Full-stack real-time multi-lot robo auction platform for up to 70 teams

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.render:build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test:concurrency --prefix server
